## The question

> What is the difference between a chatbot and an AI agent?

**The walkaway:**

> A chatbot answers. An agent answers and takes steps, inside the permissions you give it.

## Script

| # | In | Type | s | Narration | Caption text (board) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 0:00.0 | hook | 6.0 | An AI that answers your question and an AI that actually does the task? They are not quite the same thing. | Chatbot or agent |
| 2 | 0:06.0 | explain | 5.0 | Think of a chatbot as someone you can ask for directions. You ask, it explains the route. | Ask for directions |
| 3 | 0:11.0 | explain | 4.0 | An AI agent is closer to an assistant that can use tools. | It can use tools |
| 4 | 0:15.0 | explain | 7.0 | You might ask it to find a meeting time. It could check an available calendar, compare slots, and prepare an invitation. | Find a meeting time |
| 5 | 0:22.0 | myth-check | 5.5 | The difference is not that one is magically intelligent. It is what the system is set up to do. | Not magic. Wiring. |
| 6 | 0:28.5 | step-by-step | 8.5 | A chatbot usually gives you a response. An agent can work through steps: plan, use a tool, check the result, then continue. | Plan, use a tool, check |
| 7 | 0:36.0 | myth-check | 7.5 | But here is the catch: agents can make mistakes, misunderstand a goal, or take an action you did not intend. | It can go wrong |
| 8 | 0:44.5 | compare | 5.0 | Important actions should have clear permissions and human approval. | Permissions and approval |
| 9 | 0:49.5 | recap | 3.0 | A chatbot responds. An agent can take steps. | Answers vs steps |
| 10 | 0:52.5 | outro | 3.5 | So remember: answers are one thing; taking steps are another. | CHATBOT is not AGENT |
